notes:
{婚約|こんやく} is a formal agreement to marry. It can be used as a noun or with する as a suru verb.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {婚約|こんやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

FORMS:
{婚|こん} (marriage) + {約|やく} (promise, agreement)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚約|こんやく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to get engaged
- {婚約|こんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break off an engagement
- {婚約|こんやく}⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧: engagement ring
- {婚約|こんやく}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: engagement announcement
- ⟦{婚約|こんやく}{者|しゃ}→婚約者：17124_konyakusha⟧: fiancé/fiancée

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, {婚約|こんやく} may be formalized through ⟦{結納|ゆいのう}→結納：19148_yuinou⟧ (a traditional betrothal ceremony involving gift exchange between families), though this practice is becoming less common in modern times.
